summary: Corporate card refund not posted; employee expense at risk of duplicate reimbursement
description:
Issue summary:
An employee submitted a corporate card expense for a client dinner on 2026-02-25 (merchant: Osteria Nuova, card ending 4421). The merchant issued a partial refund on 2026-03-02 but the refund has not posted to Redwood's corporate card clearing account. Finance is concerned the employee will be reimbursed twice (expense report + merchant refund) unless the ledger is reconciled and the expense is marked appropriately.

Impact:
- One employee reimbursement at risk of duplicate payment (~€186.45).
- Potential mismatch on month-end card reconciliation for February/Early-March in eu-west region.
- Low immediate business impact but medium reconciliation/controllership exposure.

Environment:
- Prod finance systems: Concur-style expense tracker (internal), clearing account on banking provider: Wise Business (EU IBAN).
- Region: eu-west.

Transaction details:
- Original charge: 2026-02-25, Osteria Nuova, EUR 232.60, corporate card ****4421, transaction id: CC-20260225-7GQ
- Merchant refund: 2026-03-02, Osteria Nuova, EUR 46.15 (partial), merchant reference: MREF-2298
- Bank clearing account statement (expected): refund not present as of 2026-03-09 statement cut.

Steps to reproduce / confirm:
1) Review employee expense report: ID EXP-77821 (report submitted by Samir Kapoor).
2) Check corporate card transactions via payment provider portal for card ****4421 (filter 2026-02-20..2026-03-10).
3) Search bank clearing account transactions for merchant reference MREF-2298 and amount 46.15 EUR.
4) Check merchant-provided correspondence (email from Osteria Nuova) and attached refund receipt.

Investigation notes so far:
- Employee (Samir) attached an email from the restaurant indicating refund processed on 2026-03-02 and provided a merchant refund receipt that shows reference MREF-2298.
- Payment provider (Wise Business) does not show a corresponding inbound transaction on the EUR clearing account for that reference.
- Merchant's refund reference uses our internal POS descriptor which is uncommon; it may have been refunded to the original payment method but routed to the customer's issuing bank instead of our clearing account (possible: merchant reversed on their side but transaction never routed).
- Treasury attempted a micro-reconciliation (match by amount and timestamp) and could not find a match.
- Banking partner advised to wait up to 7 business days for merchant-side reversals to settle; today is day 8 since refund date.

Attachments / logs:
- Employee refund email (attached to Jira) - refund_receipt_20260302.pdf
- Expense report export (CSV) - EXP-77821.csv
- Bank statement extract (anonymized) - clearing_eu_20260309.csv

Requested action:
- Finance/Treasury to contact merchant point-of-sale acquirer to confirm refund settlement path and whether a chargeback was issued.
- If merchant refund did not reach our clearing account, open a merchant dispute / chargeback with acquirer; raise ticket with treasury bank operations.
- Put expense report EXP-77821 on hold to prevent reimbursement until refund is reconciled or employee is cleared.
- If merchant refund confirms but ledger cannot be corrected in time for month close, apply manual journal entry to net refund to card clearing account and annotate in Confluence runbook.

Acceptance / resolution criteria:
- Either refund transaction is observed in the clearing account and expense report is adjusted, OR a finance journal is posted to reflect the refund and the employee reimbursement is prevented.

Notes for follow-up:
- Add a short how-to to Confluence on corporate-card partial refunds and mapping merchant references (point to related_confluence_page).
- Consider flagging corporate cards with recurring merchant mismatches for closer monitoring.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Emma Chen (Reporter): Filed after Samir forwarded merchant refund receipt. Employee says he already saw 'refund processed' from the restaurant but it hasn't landed in card account.

2026-03-11 - Priya Patel (Treasury): I checked Wise Business portal and bank extract; no inbound for 46.15 EUR. Reached out to bank ops, they suggest contacting merchant acquirer with merchant reference.
2026-03-12 - Samir Kapoor (Employee): Confirming I did not receive a credit on my personal card either (I used corporate virtual card). I attached the restaurant email and their telephone number.

2026-03-12 - Diego Morales (Finance Analyst, Assignee): Placing EXP-77821 on hold in expense system to prevent payment. Started acquirer inquiry; ticket with acquirer created (ACQ-5567). If we don't see a settlement by 2026-03-16 we will escalate to chargeback.

2026-03-13 - Bank Ops (External): Bank responded — no inbound refund traceable to our IBAN; suggested merchant-side reversal may have been applied to original issuing BIN. Requested acquirer proof of settlement. Awaiting acquirer response.

2026-03-14 - Diego Morales: Next step — if acquirer cannot provide settlement proof we will initiate chargeback. Finance to prepare manual journal entry template to be used if required for month close; will post here when ready.
resolution: Investigation ongoing. Expense EXP-77821 placed on hold. Acquirer ticket ACQ-5567 opened. Treasury to escalate to chargeback if acquirer cannot prove settlement by 2026-03-16.
workaround: Do not reimburse EXP-77821. Mark report status as 'Pending refund reconciliation' and notify employee. Prepare manual journal in case refund does not post before month-end close.
next_steps: Finance to follow up with acquirer (ACQ-5567) and post acquirer response here
If no settlement proof by 2026-03-16, initiate chargeback and create GL journal to offset expense
Update Confluence with findings and add merchant to monitoring list if mismatch confirmed
